sections.title: 29+ Hooks: Lifecycle Events Reference
sections.description: Complete guide to all lifecycle hooks in Claude Code

hooks.name: SessionStart
hooks.useCase: Load project context (git status, task board, recent changes)

hooks.name: PreToolUse
hooks.useCase: Block dangerous commands, enforce security policies, log all tool calls

hooks.name: PermissionRequest
hooks.useCase: Auto-approve read-only operations (ls, cat, grep) to reduce friction

hooks.name: PostToolUseFailure
hooks.useCase: Error tracking, send failures to Sentry/DataDog, suggest recovery

hooks.name: CwdChanged
hooks.useCase: Reactive environment (direnv), reload env vars, restart dev servers

hooks.name: InstructionsLoaded
hooks.useCase: Audit logging, compliance tracking, notify on instruction changes

hooks.name: ConfigChange
hooks.useCase: Reload config, validate changes, restart necessary services

hooks.name: SubagentStart
hooks.useCase: Setup subagent context, configure permissions, logging

hooks.name: TaskCreated
hooks.useCase: Validate task creation, enforce rate limits, logging

hooks.name: PreCompact
hooks.useCase: Prepare critical information for compaction, logging, prevent compaction of sensitive data

sections.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration Patterns
sections.description: 3 proven patterns for coordinating multiple agents

patterns.name: Pipeline Pattern
patterns.description: Sequential agent execution where output of one feeds input to next
patterns.useCase: Complex multi-step tasks: research problem → analyze solutions → write summary

patterns.name: Parallel Pattern
patterns.description: Multiple agents work on same problem simultaneously, results merged
patterns.useCase: Diverse expertise: frontend expert, backend expert, infra expert on same feature

patterns.name: Hierarchical Pattern
patterns.description: Master agent delegates to specialist subagents, coordinates results
patterns.useCase: Quality review: agents check different aspects (code review, security, performance)
patterns.bestFor: Quality gates, multi-criteria evaluation, risk assessment

quiz.question: ¿Cuál es el primer paso para empaquetar un MCP en formato .mcpb?
quiz.explanation: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/mcpb instala la herramienta CLI necesaria para empaquetar MCPs

quiz.question: ¿Cuántos eventos hook existen en settings.json?
quiz.explanation: Claude Code soporta 29+ eventos: SessionStart, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, CwdChanged, SubagentStart, TaskCreated, PreCompact, y más

quiz.question: ¿Cuál hook permite bloquear comandos peligrosos?
quiz.explanation: PreToolUse se ejecuta ANTES de la herramienta y es blocking, permitiendo validar/bloquear comandos como 'rm -rf /'

quiz.question: ¿Qué es el patrón 'Pipeline' en orquestación multi-agente?
options: Todos los agentes trabajan en paralelo
Un agente central delega a especialistas
quiz.explanation: Pipeline Pattern: output de agente 1 → input de agente 2 → input de agente 3 (ejecución secuencial)

quiz.question: ¿Cuál es la diferencia entre 'blocking: true' y 'blocking: false' en hooks?
options: No hay diferencia, es solo documentación
blocking:true = puede detener/modificar evento, blocking:false = solo lectura
blocking:true = corre en paralelo, blocking:false = corre secuencial
blocking:true = se ejecuta siempre, blocking:false = se ejecuta a veces
quiz.explanation: blocking:true permite validar/rechazar comandos (PreToolUse, PermissionRequest). blocking:false es solo observación/logging
